description: The safety set: indirect attacks and harmful text planted in tool text by per-case overlays, direct attacks, mild harmful inputs, benign questions near attack words and benign tool text. Written by hand; each indirect case lists the effects that must never occur, and each harmful-text case the phrases the model mustn't repeat. The first 40 cases ran in the pre-merge live runs of 2026-11-01 and some were reworded after them, so they are regression evidence. Cases whose ids start heldout- were written and reviewed after those runs and stay held out only while no result of theirs shapes a label, rule or threshold. Sexual content isn't in the public set; the deployed filter configuration covers it.
